title: "Resume"
format:

    toc: false
---

<style>
:root {
  --resume-blue: #003262;
  --resume-gold: #FDB515;
  --resume-green: #18864b;
  --resume-sky: #2674c8;
  --resume-purple: #7656a8;
  --resume-orange: #d9822b;
  --resume-ink: #22384d;
  --resume-muted: #657485;
  --resume-border: #dde6ee;
}

.resume-hero {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 28px;
  padding: 32px 34px;
  margin: 8px 0 30px;
  border-radius: 22px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--resume-blue) 0%, #0a4f8f 100%);
  box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 50, 98, 0.18);
  color: white;
}

.resume-eyebrow {
  margin-bottom: 7px;
  color: var(--resume-gold);
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: 0.09em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.resume-hero h1 {
  margin: 0 0 8px;
  color: white;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.04em;
}

.resume-hero p {
  max-width: 680px;
  margin: 0;
  color: #eef6ff;
  font-size: 1.03rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.resume-download {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 9px;
  padding: 13px 19px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.42);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: white;
  color: var(--resume-blue) !important;
  font-weight: 800;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
}

.resume-download:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
}

.timeline {
  --section-color: var(--resume-sky);
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 34px;
  padding: 4px 0 2px 28px;
}

.timeline::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 4px;
  bottom: 2px;
  left: 5px;
  width: 5px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--section-color);
}

.timeline.summary { --section-color: var(--resume-blue); }
.timeline.education { --section-color: var(--resume-green); }
.timeline.experience { --section-color: var(--resume-sky); }
.timeline.additional { --section-color: var(--resume-orange); }
.timeline.volunteer { --section-color: var(--resume-gold); }
.timeline.skills { --section-color: var(--resume-purple); }

.timeline > h2 {
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  color: var(--section-color);
  font-size: 1.45rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.timeline-item {
  position: relative;
  margin: 0 0 16px;
  padding: 22px 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--resume-border);
  border-radius: 17px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
  box-shadow: 0 7px 22px rgba(0, 50, 98, 0.055);
  color: var(--resume-ink);
}

.timeline-item::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 27px;
  left: -29px;
  width: 13px;
  height: 13px;
  border: 3px solid var(--section-color);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: white;
}

.timeline-item h3 {
  margin: 0 0 3px;
  color: var(--resume-blue);
  font-size: 1.14rem;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.role {
  margin: 0;
  color: #344b61;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.date {
  display: inline-block;
  margin: 7px 0 12px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #f0f5f9;
  color: var(--resume-muted);
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.timeline-item ul {
  margin: 10px 0 0;
  padding-left: 1.25rem;
}

.timeline-item li {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  line-height: 1.62;
}

.timeline-item li:last-child {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.summary-copy {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: 1.02rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.skill-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 12px;
}

.skill-card {
  padding: 15px 16px;
  border: 1px solid #e5e0ee;
  border-radius: 13px;
  background: #fbf9ff;
  line-height: 1.58;
}

.skill-card strong {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 3px;
  color: #4d3674;
}

.resume-footer {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  margin: 34px 0 48px;
}

@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .resume-hero {
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    padding: 26px 22px;
  }

  .resume-download {
    width: 100%;
  }

  .timeline {
    padding-left: 23px;
  }

  .timeline-item {
    padding: 19px 17px;
  }

  .timeline-item::before {
    left: -24px;
  }

  .skill-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}
</style>

### Crestline Quota-Share Reinsurance Case Study

<p class="role">Financial Analysis Project</p>
<p class="date">July 2026 - August 2026 · Fremont, CA</p>

- Evaluated a proposed $1.0M quota-share reinsurance deal (50% cession, 32.5% ceding commission) by rebuilding six years of loss ratios from a 4,577-row policy bordereaux and loss run, deriving a 59% break-even loss ratio to frame the decision.
- Identified data-quality failures using accounting identity checks (written = earned + unearned), uncovering 15 erroneous policy rows, formulaic patterns, and missing IBNR; found that an AI-generated memo understated two loss years by 10-21 percentage points.
- Built an expected loss ratio model (68%, sensitivity band 65-72%) incorporating cost-trend drift and a Poisson-based catastrophe load, then presented findings and defended the methodology to senior reinsurance professionals, recommending restructured terms.
- **[Explore the interactive underwriting analytics application](finance.qmd).**

</div>
